paragraphs: Week 1 kicked the door in, and Slayday Barbie brought the fireworks: 169.46 points, Winner of the Week, and a Steamroller win. Casual opening statement.
Shannon’s Serving Punt and Milk These TDs matched at 144.50 points, landing at No. 2 and No. 3. Apparently sharing is caring, even when the thing being shared is league-wide anxiety.
The Waffles Special put up 123.30 and still took the loss, earning the Hard Luck Hero badge and proving that a respectable score can still become emotional damage.
One week down, fifteen teams already plotting revenge, and absolutely nobody allowed to relax. Welcome back to the chaos.
